scope: Foundation-only native Mac loading-method mechanics with declared ID-only transfer, image, preparation and append spies. No real photo decoding or UI lifecycle execution.

source.correction: Check the token before each transfer, after transfer before preparation, and after preparation; split the former combined await guard. Preserve final/catch protection. No new task lifecycle state.
source.fileScopeLimit: The corrected whole-file snapshot also includes two loading-overlay foreground-style changes outside these extracted methods; this unit check does not verify their rendering.

harness.sourceTransformation: Each variant extracts its actual methods. One outer capturedTask = assignment permits awaiting completion; its Task expression/closure bytes remain unchanged. Invalidation method bytes are exact.

declaredSpies.PhotosPickerItem: Fixed transfer outcomes controlled by explicit continuations.
declaredSpies.MealPhotoPreparation: Records requests and fixed success/nil outcomes; no decoder.
declaredSpies.appendPersonalPhotos: Records IDs/role and invokes actual invalidation to preserve its token/busy-reset contract only.

harness.ordering: Explicit actor witnesses and checked-continuation releases; no ordering sleeps.

baseline.interpretation: After invalidation during transfer, A1 still requested preparation and A2/A3 requested transfer/preparation after B completed. After invalidation during preparation, A2/A3 still requested work while B was active.
baseline.protectionsAlreadyPassed: No stale append, error, busy reset or state write changed completed/active B. Stale-failure and active success/failure controls passed.

limits: The eight deterministic schedules are not proof of every possible concurrency interleaving.
Spies are not PhotosUI/UIKit, actual image decoding, camera authorization, SwiftUI @State lifetime, navigation/disappearance or physical-device evidence.
Stopping later requests does not interrupt an already-started transfer/preparation or establish OS compute cancellation.
No measured memory or performance improvement is established; earlier high-peak preparation memory remains unresolved.
Role checks cover forwarded request limits only, not real output pixel bounds.
Source fragments, raw logs and executables remain local; no app package, delivery or distribution claim follows from this unit evidence.
